independent_route: Derive probability of nu_y from actual normalization103 plus its exact product-law equality, and probability of P from the actual unit-exponential product. Fix y,r,T without introducing a kernel, restart law, or transition-provider premise.

Set mu=nu_y times P; e(z,w)=Z(y,r,z,T,w). Actual106 gives e_*mu=nu_y. The initial projection p(z,w)=z preserves nu_y since P has mass one. Hence B:f->f composed p and C:f->f composed e are well-defined L2 linear isometries.

Define Q=B.adjoint composed C using the generic complete Hilbert L2 spaces. This generic adjoint is available before, and independently of, the source target A.3. Norm(Q)<=1 follows directly from norm(B)<=1, norm(C)<=1 and adjoint norm preservation.

For arbitrary hG:MemLp G 2 nu_y, pull back hG under e to get actual product MemLp. Product finiteness gives L1; Fubini then yields almost-everywhere clock-section integrability and L1 of A_G(z)=integral G(e(z,w)) dP. This step does not assume that A_G is L2.

For every measurable set S, its indicator is L2 because nu_y is finite. Pair Q[G] with this indicator, use the adjoint identity, representative-safe pullbacks, L2 inner-product integral formula and signed Fubini. The indicator times G(e) is product-integrable, since its absolute value is bounded by |G(e)|. Thus set integrals of Q[G] and A_G agree. Both are already L1, so L1 set-integral uniqueness identifies them almost everywhere.

Transport that equality to MemLp A_G and Q(hG.toLp G)=hOp.toLp A_G. If G=H nu_y-a.e., endpoint measure preservation transfers equality to mu-a.e.; product-to-iterated-a.e. transfer and integral_congr_ae give A_G=A_H nu_y-a.e. This also explains why no pointwise representative invariance is asserted.

For every Borel G, joint measurability of Z and the measurable total-integral API give jointly Borel A_G in all displayed finite parameters, even when some sections are nonintegrable under the total Bochner convention. Bounded Borel G has every section integrable and the same bound C. For L2 G obtain the square-integral contraction from the operator norm and representative identity. At zero time, Z0=z P-a.e. for each z implies the corresponding clock integral equals G(z) for each z; equality in L2 gives Q0=id. No common exceptional set over parameters is needed.
